cohort: 181 pregnant patients who presented for routine pregnancy visits to a Private Etlik Lokman Hekim Hospital between March 2019 and March 2020.
finding: Third-trimester fetal clavicle length was significantly related to birth weight and shoulder dystocia, providing a practical and significant method for predicting macrosomia and shoulder dystocia.
mod_finding: No significant difference was observed for second or third trimester clavicle length between types of delivery.
cross-section timing: Measurements taken at 20-23 weeks and 33-36 weeks gestation, and outcomes assessed during the second stage of labor.
birth_weight: Recorded for all neonates; macrosomia defined as >=4100 g.
gest_age: Measurements taken at 20-23 weeks and 33-36 weeks gestation.
